{{Otheruses|Belt}}
'''Ubese clan belt-clasps''', were small belt buckles with different symbols and markings that [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] usually wore, so that other Ubese could easily tell which clan certain Ubese belonged to.<ref name="Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary">[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]</ref>
